āṇatti.p: [Āṇa+ṇāpe+ti] (thī) CL=8 command (someone) to do , order.

B:
āṇatti：āṇatti（thī）
အာဏတ္တိ（ထီ）
«āṇa+ṇāpe+ti»
[အာဏ+ဏာပေ+တိ]
P: Āṇatti，（f.） [ā + ñatti （cp. āṇāpeti），Caus. of jñā] order，command，ordinance，injunction Vin.I，62； KhA 29； PvA.260； Sdhp.59，354. （Page 97）
K:
āṇatti：အာဏတ္တိ（ထီ）
[အာဏ+ဏာပေ+တိ]
စေခိုင်းခြင်း၊ အမိန့်ပေးခြင်း။
R:
āṇatti：အာ-ဏတ္တိ（ဣ）
စေခိုင်းခြင်း။ နှင်ခြင်း။ တိုက်တွန်းခြင်း။
DOP: āṇatti f. [ BHS id.; cf S. ājñapti], order, command; (gr.t.t.) (the sense of) the imperative mood ; Vin I 62, 17 (pañca nissayapaṭippassaddhiyo upajjhāyamhā … ~i yeva pañcamī); Ja IV 113, 24´ (bhagavato ~iyā panāyasmatā Ānandena bhikkhusaṅghe sannipatite); 418, 26 (kiṃ nu kho esa luddo maṃ gaṇhanto attano kammena gaṇhi udāhu aññassa ~iyā ti); Peṭ 43, 20 (katamā ~i); Ps III 163, 18 (iṅghā ti ~iyaṃ nipāto); Spk III 92, 16 (tesaṃ ~iyo evaṃ āha, Ee so, perhaps wr; Be, Ce, Se anujānanto); Kkh 63, 19 (dhovā ti ādikāya ~iyā); Sadd 50, 24* (atītanāgato paccuppanno ~i-m-eva ca parikappo ca kālassa atipattī ti chabbidho); 542, 18 (cuda sañcodane ~iyaṃ ca: codeti); — °- kālika , mfn. , (belonging to) the imperative mood ; Sadd 50, 3 (pañcamīvibhatti ~ā); 56, 35 ; — °- niyāmaka , m. [āṇatti + niyāmaka 1 ], a way of ordering, a form of command ; Pj I 29, 29* (ime cha ~ā, Be, Ce so; Ee āṇattī niyāmakā; Se āṇattī niyāmatā) = Sp 446, 13* ; — °- vacana , n. , (an expression of) the imperative mood ; Thī-a 5, 33 (supāhī ti ~aṃ); Sadd 50, 3 (pañcamīvibhatyantāni padāni ~āni); — anāṇatti , f. , not a command, lack of an order ; Sp 352, 22 (~iyā gahitattā); 968, 31 .
CPD: āṇatti , f. [ Amg. id.; sa. ājñapti], 1. command, order, injunction; Sadd 813, 30 (= āṇāpana, cf . Kkh 22, 25 ), 542, 18 (= sañcodana, √cud); Peṭ 23, 9 f. ; 43, 20 —45, 16 ; Nett 7, 1 ff. ; nom. sg. yattha ~i n'atthi, Kkh 158, 6 ; sa ~i yathâdhippāyaṃ gacchati, Sp (ll) 369, 14 ; acc. sg. ~iṃ pavattetvā, Mp ll 253, 15 ; ~iṃ karoti, Ja V 238, 21 ' ad 238, 12* (= niddesaṃ); ~iṃ kuruto niccaṃ, Pañca-g 98; instr, sg. dhovâ ti ādikāya ~iyā, Kkh 63, 19 ; bhagavato ~iyā, Ja lV 113, 24 ; aññassa ~iyā, ib. 418, 26 ≠ 427, 9 ; ~iyā kārentassa, Spk ll 339, 17 ; mama ~iyā suṇātha, Sv (l)171, 22 ≠ Spk ll 7, 23 ; loc. sg. ~iyaṃ, Sv (l) 171, 18 ; Spk ll 7, 19 ; Kkh 158, 6 ; Ud-a 174, 2 (bhagavato ~iyaṃ tiṭṭhanto); acc. pl. tesaṃ ~iyo evam āha, Spk lll 92, 16 ; 2. ( Gr. ) expressed by pañcamī ( imper. ); Kacc 417 (ānatti) = Rūp 435 = Bālāv § 24; Pay fol. chi ad Mogg Vl 10; Sadd 33, 13 (āṇati); 813, 26 ; cf. Vin l 62, 17 ,21 = V 129, 11 (~i yeva pañcamī); 3. one of the 6 'kāla' ( grammatical tenses ): Sadd 20, 25 ; 50, 24* ; 56, 4 ; — ifc. v. aniyamitâ ° (Spk l 80, 21 ; 107, 19 ), nissaggâ ° (Khuddas l 7), yathâ ° (Saddh 354), yathâdhippāya(m) ° (Saddh 59, 62 ). °(y)attha, m., denotation, signification of com- mand; Kacc-v 417; Rūp 435; Bālāv § 24; Sv (l) 171, 22 ; Spk ll 7, 23 . — ° kara , m., a messenger; Ja ll 435, 24 ' ad 435, 18* (= dūta). — ° kālika , mfn., be- longing to the āṇatti-kāla; Sadd 50, 3 ; 56, 35 .—° kkhaṇa , m.; loc. sg. āṇāpakassa ~e, Sp (ll) 446, 26 (369, 15 ; 370, 14 ); Kkh 27, 41 ( at the moment when an order of an authority is given ). — ° niyāma , m.; instr, sg. as an adverb ~ena, Pv-a 260, 18 ( according to an order ). — ° niyāmaka , m., way or manner of giving an order; nom. pl. cha ~ā, Pj l 29, 29* ( E e S e āṇattī niy°) = Sp (ll) 446, 13* = Kkh 31, 12* ( cf . Kkh-ṭ 83, 25 ) ≠ Khuddas l 8 ( the 6 are: vatthu, kāla, okāsa, āvudha, iriyāpatha, kiriyāvisesa or kriyāvisesa); Vin-vn 255 ( here: vatthu, kāla, desa, sattha, iriyāpatha, karaṇassa visesa). —° pakkha m.; loc. sg. ~e, Ss 117, 17 ( with regard to an order ). — ° payogasādhika , mfn.; nom. pl. ~ā, Kkh-ṭ 83, 25 . — ° parikappika , mfn.; f. ~ikā, sc. vibhattiyo, Sadd 50, 26 ff . (āṇatti and parikappa). — ° mattena , Ps lll 51, 7 . — ° mūlaka , mfn.; Mp ll 275, 2 , 12. — ° vacana , n.; Sadd 50, 3 ; Thī-a 6, 7 . — ° vasena , Kkh 28, 7 ( cf . Kkh-t 84, 14* ). — ° vāra , m.; Sp (ll) 370, 7 ( four ). — ° āpatti , f.; Kkh 22, 2* ( ct. 22, 25 ').
NCP: feminine | aa.natti order, command; (the sense of) the imperative mood.

āṇattika.p: [Āṇatti+ṇika] (ti) CL=8 By force of command,  ( such as stealth, kill which is command to do like this).
a: အာဏတ္တိက(တိ)

B:
āṇattika：āṇattika（ti）
အာဏတ္တိက（တိ）
«āṇatti+ṇika»
[အာဏတ္တိ+ဏိက]
P: Āṇattika，（adj.） [āṇatti + ka] belonging to an ordinance or command，of the nature of an injunction KhA 29. （Page 97）
K:
āṇattika：အာဏတ္တိက（တိ）
[အာဏတ္တိ+ဏိက]
စေခိုင်း-အမိန့်ပေး-ခြင်းဖြင့်ဖြစ်သော၊ （စေခိုင်း၍ ပြုလုပ်အပ်သော ခိုးခြင်း，သတ်ခြင်း-စသည်）။
R:
āṇattika：အာဏတ္တိ-က（တိ）
စေခိုင်းခြင်း ဖြစ်သော။
DOP: āṇattika ( and āṇattiya), mfn. [āṇatti + ka 2 ], involving a command; done by ordering (someone else) ; Sp 366, 26 (eko māsako sāhatthiko hoti … pañca ~ā); 366, 29 (sāhatthikaṃ vā ~assa ~aṃ vā sāhatthikassa aṅgaṃ na hoti, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se āṇattiyassa āṇattiyaṃ); 439, 18 (pāṇātipātassa cha ppayogā sāhatthiko ~o nissaggiyo …~o ti aññaṃ āṇāpentassa evaṃ vijjhitvā paharitvā vā mārāpehī ti āṇāpanaṃ, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee āṇattiyo) ≠ Kkh 30, 40 ( Be so; Ce, Ee āṇattiyo) ≠ Sv 70, 1 ≠ Pj I 29, 9 ; As 161, 21 foll. (puññaṃ hi atthi sayaṃkāraṃ … atthi ~aṃ … āṇāpetvā kāritaṃ ~aṃ nāma); Vin-vn 245 (bhikkhuno parass’ āṇāpanaṃ nāma ayaṃ ~o nayo); 254; — anāṇattika , mfn. [ or a 3 + āṇatti + ka 2 , or from a 3 + āṇattikā], not involving a command, not done by ordering someone else ; Kkh 25, 8 (āṇattiyā anāpajjitabbato ~aṃ); — see also sāṇattika.
CPD: āṇattika , mfn., belonging to a command or an injunction; as a noun: 1. m., one of the 6 "methods of killing": sāhatthika, ~, nissaggiya, thāvara, vijjāmaya, iddhimaya; nom. sg. ~o, Sp (ll) 439, 21 ( E e āṇattiyo = aññaṃ āṇāpentassa evaṃ vijjhitvā vā paharitvā vā mārāpehî ti āṇāpanaṃ, ad Vin lll 71, 29 ; cf. Sp-ṭ B e ll 238, 29 ); sāḥatthiko ~iko nis- saggiye, Kkh 27, 35 ( Ct. asukassa bhaṇḍaṃ avaharâ ti aññaṃ āṇāpeti nissaggiye nāma, 27, 37 ); ~o nayo, Vin-vn 245; ~o payogo, sc. pāṇātipātassa, Pj l 29, 9 and 25 (adhiṭṭhahitvā āṇāpanaṃ), Vin-vn 254 b, Spk ll 144, 31 = Ps l 198, 22 ' = Sp (ll)439, 18 ; 446, 6 = lt-a ll 50, 9 ; As 97, 26 ( cf. Khuddas l 7); instr. ~âdīhi (payogehi), Pj ll 493, 18 ; 2. f ., = āṇatti; instr, sg. satthu ~āya, Mp l 259, 13 ( S e ānattiyā); — ifc. an- ° (Kkh 25, 8 ; 35, 30 foll. ), sâ ° (Kkh 30, 14 ). — — ° -(p)payoga , m. , Sp (ll) 448, 15 ; Kkh 32, 1 ; Kkh-ṭ 83, 25-26 . — ° -vacana , n.; Kkh 2, 23 .
